blends.name: 🍌Simian® | Cycling Caps
blends.desc:
### The 🍌Simian® Pedal Emporium is celebrating the first Kandi Wear™ custom cycling caps.
### 

1. Blend 3 🍌Simian® | Apecash Assets for the 🍌Simian® | Cycling Caps Asset
2. Use the 🍌Simian® | Cycling Caps Asset in our discord channel to gain access to the private channel #em-cycling-caps
